description: Smart closure monitoring for surgical sites. In the Smart Bandages with Automated Drug Release system this piece plays the post-op role: it watches incisions Maturity: pilot.

how_it_works: Assemble the Surgical Incision from its qualified components.
Wire its interfaces (power, data, control, mechanical) to the system bus.

Integrate with the full system and re-run the acceptance suite.
